|rulings='''[[Players Committee]] rulings'''
* May not relocate opponent's cards.<ref name="pc-card-data">[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json swccg-card-json Dark.json], Players Committee, Evacuate? (GEMP ID 1_245, commit d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020183206/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json Internet Archive] (20 October 2026).</ref>
* May not relocate weapons and devices deployed directly upon a starship or vehicle (e.g. [[Deflector Shield Generators]] or [[Turbolaser Battery]]).<ref name="pc-card-data" />
* If relocating to a capital starship, it must have capacity for everything and all of the cards must be allowed to exist there.<ref name="pc-card-data" />
* If relocating to a capital starship, it must be to the starship card itself, not a starship site.<ref name="pc-card-data" />
